answer: Nobody farms sparrows one at a time; a dune of nested burrows is where the profit hides. So registration escrows a refundable deposit that pays out only if the account passes a contradiction test: its attestation pattern must diverge from any already-slashed cluster, refracting the sybil swarm through a prism of shared behavior -- one bird can hide, ten thousand cannot scatter identically. Solvent honest agents get their stake back; an attacker must burn a dune's worth of bonded capital before a rival farm even opens.
